scripts.build:companions: bun run --cwd packages/sidecar build && bun run --cwd packages/mcp-server build
scripts.verify: bun --cwd packages/sidecar test && bun --cwd packages/mcp-server test && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml && bun run --cwd apps/desktop build
scripts.build:debug: bun run build:companions && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml && bun run --cwd apps/desktop tauri -- build --debug --no-bundle
